title: Keep a prescribed reset while consuming clean channel programs
statement: A separately reported PBT construction consumes independent Choi programs of arbitrary T, fills EVERY failure with preparable reset omega and thins excess successes to implement exactly p T+(1-p)R_omega. For qubit input17 product Choi programs exceed p=2/3where16 do not. Programs from a noisy source do not automatically supply Choi programs of its clean component; a rank-deficient reset needs its own acquisition argument.

requires: Specified mixed encoder plus input-independent reset model, known logical/ambient dimensions and positive actual reset floor
Fresh stationary calibration outputs for supplied ordinary known inputs; same actual source for future uses
Trusted paid receiver/exchange ancilla maximally mixed and ambient circuit controls
